artifact: derm7pt perception baseline (frozen encoder + linear probe)
purpose: classifier-only arm R0, and the classifier side of gate G5 (does classifier-vs-criteria disagreement predict error?)

status.note: Test-split numbers are reported here because this artifact CHARACTERISES a baseline; they are not a confirmatory system claim and must not be cited as one. Nothing -- not the probe weights, not C, not the temperature -- was fit or selected on valid or test.

dataset.name: Derm7pt
dataset.license: CC BY-NC-ND (no image bytes are stored in this artifact)

encoder.selection_reason: dermlip resolved from the local checkpoint cache; it is the first choice because v1 used it

probe.calibration: temperature scaling; T fit on out-of-fold TRAIN logits only. Dividing logits by T > 0 preserves every argmax, so predictions are identical with and without it.

cross_validation.selection_metric: mean out-of-fold multinomial log-loss (lower is better)
cross_validation.temperature_fit_on: out-of-fold train logits at the selected C
